news.headline: WTI crude -2.05% to $101.15; Brent -1.73% to $109.77
news.what_happened: Crude eased about 2% in the latest session but remains above $100/bbl.
news.why_it_matters: Fuel and crude-derivative costs ease at the margin for airlines and paints; OMC and upstream realisations dip. Absolute oil level is still elevated, so the relief is modest.

news.headline: US stocks lower: S&P 500 -0.52%, Nasdaq -0.21%; US 10Y yield up to 4.99%
news.what_happened: Wall Street closed lower while the 10-year Treasury yield rose about 0.7% to near 5%.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off tone and a high US yield are a headwind for FII flows into India and for rate-sensitive sectors.

news.headline: Asia soft: Nikkei -0.58%, Hang Seng -0.11%; Nifty closed 22,600 (-0.39%)
news.what_happened: Asian indices slipped; Nifty 50 ended the prior session at 22,600.
news.why_it_matters: Weak regional cues point to a cautious open. USD/INR is flat near 94.93 so there is no currency trigger for IT or pharma.

sector_outlook.reason: Hang Seng flat, no China data trigger found
